verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs say games can be compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and native desktop apps, but only through third-party tools rather than a built-in export pipeline. Community reports confirm mobile packaging works (Cocoon to the app stores, an Android .apk running at 60fps), with one report of slow WebGL in iOS web views when wrapped with Cordova. Missing for 10: any console export path (direct or via partners), first-party desktop and mobile export tooling, and documented single-project multi-target build workflows.
